event.title: Gyirong–Rasuwa flood
event.lede: On 26 August 2026 rock and ice broke off Langtang Lirung and a debris-laden flood swept down the border valley into Nepal.
facts: Collapse at about 8:37 am Nepal time on the northern flank of the Langtang Lirung massif (ICIMOD).
The flood reached Betrawati at about 9:20 am (ICIMOD).

maturity.text: No NISAR analysis for this event yet; it comes in a later stage. The images are Copernicus Sentinel-2 true colour made here, and images and maps published by ESA and UNOSAT.

finding.text: UNOSAT data of 2 September 2026: about 65 km² of the roughly 1,246 km² it examined appears to be affected by the flood.
